This is pretty much a newer version of Secret of Mana lol.

To be honest, for an over the top view rpg, im a little impressed by the playability, as well a the story. In ways, it reminds me of Gaia from super nintendo with the graphics, mixed a little with final fantasy. There are a few bugs, specifically the one where the enemies are forever spawning, with no slow to the rate at which they do, as well as spawning right on top of you. It is still very early, so i expect a couple bugs. I would to see where you take this game, and how you continue the story. Good luck!
